description: Changes how many new people an active campaign adds each day (0 turns daily additions off; at most 500). It authorizes spending every day, so it takes two calls: the first, with confirm false, only returns the new monthly credit ceiling and changes nothing; a call with confirm true and that same monthlyCredits applies it. Only a workspace owner or admin can change it. This is people added per day, not a sending limit: each account still sends within its own limits (LinkedIn about 30 a day per account), so people beyond what the accounts send wait in the cadence, and sendingNote says so. When the result has cappedAt, the workspace still takes at most that many a day. Every answer has dailySource: where the new people come from (source: sheet, signal or search) and the contacts each one is looked up for (channels; cadenceChannels are the ones the cadence has a step on). Pass source and/or channels to change them (only channels in cadenceChannels): the quote prices the new choice, and the confirming call sends the same values.

channels.description: The contacts each new person is looked up for (whatsapp = the mobile); omit to keep them (dailySource.channels).

monthlyCredits.description: The ceiling the first call returned, echoed on the confirming call.

source.description: Where the new people of each day come from; omit to keep it (dailySource.source).
